override.tagline:
Turn your someday
into a plan.

script: Someday isn't a day. || It's not on your calendar, and honestly, it never will be. || So give your dream a real date. Something like, publish my first novel by 2027. || Then break it into milestones. Outline the story, finish the first draft, find ten beta readers. || And pick one small thing you can do today. Write five hundred words. That's it. || Not someday. Today. || Dmyor turns your someday into a plan.
